shared_elements: upright monolithic slab/pillar bearing carved figures
figure(s) rendered in raised relief against a flat vertical field
schematic anthropomorphic/animal body with narrow limbs projecting from a bulbous torso
carving occupying the central vertical axis of the stone face
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs carrying schematic figures in raised relief with simplified, rounded bodies and thin projecting limbs, which is the most specific correspondence, and both keep the imagery on the flat frontal face of the pillar. But A shows a single large, near-freestanding anthropomorphic figure dominating the whole field, while B shows a crowded programme of small profile animals — quadrupeds, a bird with hooked bill, an insect-like creature — organised into stacked registers separated by a band of zigzag/net pattern, an arrangement with no counterpart in A.
